name: Faithful illustrated talk companion
audience: Software engineers, SREs, incident responders, and technical leaders who want the talk in a durable reading format
sourcePolicy: Shared extraction corpus only; no external research and no outputs from other experiments
workflow: Read the complete timestamped transcript including Q&A
Construct a chronological argument outline from source segments
Select exact short quotations and representative minute-sampled frames
Write a detailed technical article that distinguishes the speaker's claims, assumptions, and examples
Review every section against timestamped source evidence
Review local HTML structure, image references, and publication readability
goodEnoughDefinition: The article faithfully reconstructs the complete prepared talk and material Q&A, is detailed enough to replace casual note-taking, remains readable as a blog post, uses source illustrations, and contains no known material invention.
missingInformation: The extracted audio contains no speaker diarization, so Q&A roles were inferred from conversational turns.
Minute sampling does not capture every slide transition; the selected illustrations are representative rather than exhaustive.
The source video does not provide the conference's canonical talk abstract or speaker biography as structured metadata.
